verses.original: Λοιπὸν οὖν ἀδελφοί ἐρωτῶμεν καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ὑμᾶς ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ ἵνα ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν πῶς δεῖ καὶ ἀρέσκειν Θεῷ τὸ καθὼς παρελάβετε παρ’ ἡμῶν καθὼς καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἵνα περισσεύητε μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: Loipon oun adelphoi erōtōmen kai parakaloumen hymas en Kyriō Iēsou hina hymas peripatein pōs dei kai areskein Theō to kathōs parelabete par’ hēmōn kathōs kai peripateite hina perisseuēte mallon
verses.literal: Finally . . . brothers we ask and encourage you in [the] Lord Jesus - - to live in a way - - that is pleasing to God - just as you have received from us This is how . . . you already live so you should do so all the more

verses.original: γὰρ οἴδατε τίνας παραγγελίας ἐδώκαμεν ὑμῖν διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar oidate tinas parangelias edōkamen hymin dia tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: For you know [the] instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus

verses.original: γάρ ἐστιν τοῦ Θεοῦ θέλημα Τοῦτο ὑμῶν ὁ ἁγιασμὸς ὑμᾶς ἀπέχεσθαι ἀπὸ τῆς πορνείας
verses.transliteration: gar estin tou Theou thelēma Touto hymōn ho hagiasmos hymas apechesthai apo tēs porneias
verses.literal: For it is - God’s will that you - should be holy You must abstain from - sexual immorality

verses.original: ἕκαστον ὑμῶν εἰδέναι κτᾶσθαι ἑαυτοῦ τὸ σκεῦος ἐν ἁγιασμῷ καὶ τιμῇ
verses.transliteration: hekaston hymōn eidenai ktasthai heautou to skeuos en hagiasmō kai timē
verses.literal: each of you must know [how] to control his [own] body in holiness and honor

verses.original: μὴ ἐν ἐπιθυμίας πάθει καθάπερ καὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ εἰδότα τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: mē en epithymias pathei kathaper kai ta ethnē ta mē eidota ton Theon
verses.literal: not in lustful passion like . . . the Gentiles who vvv do not know - God

verses.original: μὴ τὸ ὑπερβαίνειν καὶ πλεονεκτεῖν αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἐν τῷ πράγματι διότι Κύριος ἔκδικος περὶ πάντων τούτων καθὼς καὶ προείπαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ διεμαρτυράμεθα
verses.transliteration: mē to hyperbainein kai pleonektein autou ton adelphon en tō pragmati dioti Kyrios ekdikos peri pantōn toutōn kathōs kai proeipamen hymin kai diemartyrametha
verses.literal: [and] no one - should {ever} violate [or] exploit his - brother in [this] regard because [the] Lord will avenge . . . all such [acts] as . . . we have already told you and solemnly warned [you]

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς οὐ ἐκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς ἐπὶ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ ἀλλ’ ἐν ἁγιασμῷ
verses.transliteration: gar ho Theos ou ekalesen hēmas epi akatharsia all’ en hagiasmō
verses.literal: For - God {has} not called us to impurity but to holiness

verses.original: ὁ τοιγαροῦν ἀθετῶν οὐκ ἀθετεῖ ἄνθρωπον ἀλλὰ τὸν Θεὸν τὸν καὶ διδόντα εἰς ὑμᾶς αὐτοῦ τὸ ἅγιον τὸ Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: ho toigaroun athetōn ouk athetei anthrōpon alla ton Theon ton kai didonta eis hymas autou to hagion to Pneuma
verses.literal: Anyone then who rejects [this command] {does} not reject man but - God the very [One who] . . . gives - you His - Holy - Spirit

verses.original: δὲ Περὶ τῆς φιλαδελφίας ἔχετε οὐ χρείαν γράφειν ὑμῖν γὰρ ὑμεῖς αὐτοὶ ἐστε θεοδίδακτοί εἰς τὸ ἀγαπᾶν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: de Peri tēs philadelphias echete ou chreian graphein hymin gar hymeis autoi este theodidaktoi eis to agapan allēlous
verses.literal: Now about - brotherly love you do not need [anyone] to write to you because you yourselves have been taught by God - - to love one another

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ποιεῖτε αὐτὸ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς τοὺς ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ δὲ Παρακαλοῦμεν ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί περισσεύειν μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: kai gar poieite auto eis pantas tous adelphous tous en holē tē Makedonia de Parakaloumen hymas adelphoi perisseuein mallon
verses.literal: And you are indeed showing this [love] to all the brothers - throughout . . . - Macedonia But we urge you brothers to excel more and more

verses.original: καὶ φιλοτιμεῖσθαι ἡσυχάζειν καὶ πράσσειν ἴδια τὰ καὶ ἐργάζεσθαι ὑμῶν ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσὶν καθὼς παρηγγείλαμεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai philotimeisthai hēsychazein kai prassein idia ta kai ergazesthai hymōn tais idiais chersin kathōs parēngeilamen hymin
verses.literal: and to aspire to live quietly - to attend to your own [matters] and to work with your - own hands as we instructed you

verses.original: ἵνα περιπατῆτε εὐσχημόνως πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω καὶ ἔχητε χρείαν μηδενὸς
verses.transliteration: hina peripatēte euschēmonōs pros tous exō kai echēte chreian mēdenos
verses.literal: Then you will behave properly toward - outsiders [without] being dependent [on anyone]

verses.original: δὲ ἀδελφοί Οὐ θέλομεν ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν περὶ τῶν κοιμωμένων ἵνα μὴ λυπῆσθε καθὼς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ οἱ ἔχοντες μὴ ἐλπίδα
verses.transliteration: de adelphoi Ou thelomen hymas agnoein peri tōn koimōmenōn hina mē lypēsthe kathōs kai hoi loipoi hoi echontes mē elpida
verses.literal: - Brothers vvv we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep [ in death ] so that vvv you will not grieve like . . . the rest who are without hope

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ πιστεύομεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ οὕτως ὁ Θεὸς ἄξει σὺν αὐτῷ τοὺς κοιμηθέντας διὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar ei pisteuomen hoti Iēsous apethanen kai anestē kai houtōs ho Theos axei syn autō tous koimēthentas dia tou Iēsou
verses.literal: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again vvv we also believe that - God will bring with [Jesus] those who have fallen asleep in - [Him]

verses.original: γὰρ Τοῦτο ἐν λόγῳ Κυρίου λέγομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι εἰς τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ Κυρίου οὐ μὴ φθάσωμεν τοὺς κοιμηθέντας
verses.transliteration: gar Touto en logō Kyriou legomen hymin hoti hēmeis hoi zōntes hoi perileipomenoi eis tēn parousian tou Kyriou ou mē phthasōmen tous koimēthentas
verses.literal: - - By [the] word of [the] Lord we declare to you that we who are alive - [and] remain until the coming of the Lord vvv vvv will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ Κύριος αὐτὸς καταβήσεται ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ ἐν κελεύσματι ἐν φωνῇ ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ ἐν σάλπιγγι Θεοῦ καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστήσονται πρῶτον
verses.transliteration: hoti ho Kyrios autos katabēsetai ap’ ouranou en keleusmati en phōnē archangelou kai en salpingi Theou kai hoi nekroi en Christō anastēsontai prōton
verses.literal: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command with the voice of an archangel and with [the] trumpet of God and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise . . .

verses.original: ἔπειτα ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι ἁρπαγησόμεθα ἅμα σὺν αὐτοῖς ἐν νεφέλαις εἰς ἀπάντησιν τοῦ Κυρίου εἰς ἀέρα καὶ οὕτως ἐσόμεθα πάντοτε σὺν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: epeita hēmeis hoi zōntes hoi perileipomenoi harpagēsometha hama syn autois en nephelais eis apantēsin tou Kyriou eis aera kai houtōs esometha pantote syn Kyriō
verses.literal: After that we who are alive - [and] remain will be caught up together with them in [the] clouds to meet the Lord in [the] air And so we will always {be} with [the] Lord

verses.original: Ὥστε παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους ἐν τούτοις τοῖς λόγοις
verses.transliteration: Hōste parakaleite allēlous en toutois tois logois
verses.literal: Therefore encourage one another with these - words
